theme: Dark Mode (Neon Cyberpunk) - Archetype 7: Electric & Neon

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-cyan-400 drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(6,182,212,0.8)]

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Headings > 32px must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Use Azeret Mono for all live scores, timers, and game data.
ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
Focus states MUST have HIGHER contrast.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds. If content scrolls underneath, use backdrop-blur + semi-solid base.

visual_enhancers.backgrounds: Use a retro neon grid background using CSS `repeating-linear-gradient` with low opacity cyan lines over the #090D16 base.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Retro-Futurism 'Terminal' Look. Deep black/indigo backgrounds with high-contrast 1px neon borders. NO soft shadows. Use hard glowing dropshadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 0.3). On active/hover, transition to 1px solid rgba(6, 182, 212, 1.0) with a neon glow (e.g. shadow-[0_0_15px_#06B6D4]).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used strictly for modals. bg-black/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and a sharp 1px cyan inner stroke.
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle CRT scanlines (CSS repeating linear gradient 1px transparent, 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.25)) layered on top of game view.

components.game_switcher_tabs: Flat dark rectangular panels. NOT rounded cards. When active, bottom border becomes 3px solid cyan with amber text. Unselected tabs are muted gray.
components.score_badges: Terminal style. Black rectangle, sharp edges, 1px amber border, glowing amber text.
components.buttons: Rectangular, sharp edges. Primary action: Cyan background, black text. Hover: Cyan glows intensely and text remains black. Secondary action: Transparent with 1px border, hover fills the color.
components.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog, stripped of its default look. Apply glassmorphism (black/80) with a glowing cyan border and sharp corners. No border-radius.
components.canvas_renderer: The game canvas must have a 2px solid cyan border with a subtle outer glow to separate it from the retro grid background.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid cramped UI.
layouts.grid: Bento-style Grid for the arcade layout. md:grid-cols-12, gap-8. Hero canvas takes col-span-full md:col-span-8 or 9. Sidebar with scores/tabs takes col-span-full md:col-span-4 or 3.
layouts.alignment: Mobile-first responsive. Ensure optical alignment over geometrical alignment.

motion.transitions: Snappy and aggressive (100ms - 200ms ease-out). Avoid slow floating animations.
motion.hover_states: -translate-y-[2px] with increased text-shadow and box-shadow glow.
motion.particles: Fast canvas-based geometric particle bursts on score/collision (cyan/amber squares and lines, not soft circles).
motion.restrictions: MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transition classes to avoid breaking transforms.

media.audio: Web Audio API synth loop. Must start muted by default. Mute/unmute button needs high visibility in top bar with a crisp SVG icon.
media.images: Not heavily reliant on photos, but background textures can be used.

hero_background.description: a computer generated image of a futuristic landscape, to be used with heavy overlay (e.g. bg-black/80) as a fallback texture if CSS grid isn't sufficient.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text. Normal text against #090D16 needs to be bright white or bright cyan/amber.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='game-tab-matiks', data-testid='mute-toggle', data-testid='copy-score-button').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: disable particle bursts and background animations if user prefers reduced motion.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: ZERO backend, ZERO database. Everything lives in browser localStorage. You MUST implement localStorage persistence for High Scores and Audio Settings.
CRITICAL: Do NOT center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align text for readability, center only specific HUD elements.
CRITICAL: Do not use HTML-based components for modals; heavily customize Shadcn UI Dialog with the retro-terminal aesthetic.
CRITICAL: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers. Use semi-solid black with heavy backdrop blur.
CRITICAL: Only use React Icons or Lucide-React for crisp HUD icons (Volume, Share, Close).
CRITICAL: Create 4 distinct canvas game files. Structure them carefully to ensure they do not memory leak when unmounting.
Provide design guidelines and implementation strictly for JS/JSX files (.js or .jsx), do NOT use TSX.
Ensure Shadcn components are modified to reflect the Cyberpunk design directly in the .jsx implementation.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
